\[
\text{slant edge} = \sqrt{(\text{side})^2 + (\text{height})^2} = \sqrt{10^2 + 12^2} = \sqrt{100 + 144} = \sqrt{244} = 12.92
\]

4. The pyramid has 8 edges in total: 4 base edges and 4 slant edges.

5. The sum of the lengths of all edges is:
\[
4 \times 10 + 4 \times 12.92 = 40 + 51.68 = 91.68
\]

6. Rounding to the nearest whole number, we get:
\[
91.68 \approx 92
\]
